title: verification findings
description: One entry per issue, from any layer of the ladder (Vale, structural, or an LLM pass). The driver validates every finding against this shape before it enters the queue.

rule.description: layer/rule id, e.g. vale/Tabletop/Regression, structural/epigram, prompts/canon-audit

quote.description: exact text flagged; reviewers must quote, never paraphrase

note.description: why it is flagged, one sentence
